instruction: Open the `Air audit format` note in Markor and use it to review the live Home air quality. Create a Markor note called `Home air audit` that ranks the three rooms with the highest PM2.5 readings and completes every published field and the final recommendation line. Do not change any purifier or purifier plan.

result.command:
test -f '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' || { echo missing; exit 0; }
ok=1
grep -Eiq '(^|[^0-9])1([^0-9]|$).*kitchen.*92.*purifier:[[:space:]]*off.*plan:[[:space:]]*none.*status:[[:space:]]*none' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' || ok=0
grep -Eiq '(^|[^0-9])2([^0-9]|$).*study.*71.*purifier:[[:space:]]*(on|running).*plan:[[:space:]]*20:00.*high.*status:[[:space:]]*active' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' || ok=0
grep -Eiq '(^|[^0-9])3([^0-9]|$).*bedroom.*58.*purifier:[[:space:]]*(on|running).*plan:[[:space:]]*none.*status:[[:space:]]*none' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' || ok=0
row1=$(grep -Ein '(^|[^0-9])1([^0-9]|$).*kitchen.*92.*purifier:[[:space:]]*off.*plan:[[:space:]]*none.*status:[[:space:]]*none' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f1)
row2=$(grep -Ein '(^|[^0-9])2([^0-9]|$).*study.*71.*purifier:[[:space:]]*(on|running).*plan:[[:space:]]*20:00.*high.*status:[[:space:]]*active' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f1)
row3=$(grep -Ein '(^|[^0-9])3([^0-9]|$).*bedroom.*58.*purifier:[[:space:]]*(on|running).*plan:[[:space:]]*none.*status:[[:space:]]*none' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$row1" ] || [ -z "$row2" ] || [ -z "$row3" ] || [ "$row1" -ge "$row2" ] || [ "$row2" -ge "$row3" ]; then ok=0; fi
grep -Eiq '^[[:space:]]*((recommendation|follow[- ]?up|next[[:space:]]+step)[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]].*|(i[[:space:]]+recommend|consider|the[[:space:]]+household[[:space:]]+should|please[[:space:]]+review|review|monitor|check|discuss)[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]].*)$' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md' || ok=0
if grep -Eiq 'purifier:[[:space:]]*(not|never)|plan:[[:space:]]*(no[[:space:]]+plan|not)|status:[[:space:]]*(not|inactive|cancel)' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Home air audit.md'; then ok=0; fi
if [ "$ok" -eq 1 ]; then echo present; else echo missing; fi
